**Brief:** link to `docs/design/<brief>.md`

## The question
One sentence.

## Options
Short list; the details are in the brief.

## Recommendation
The agent's pick. The owner may choose differently.

## What happens next
The owner writes the ADR in their own words; the agent then builds it. Work that does not depend on this goes on meanwhile.

## If nothing is decided
What waits, and what (if anything) breaks.
